page.overview:
Who is Bolaire Lathalia?

is a warlock played by Taliesin Jaffe in Campaign Four.

When first introduced, Bolaire appeared as a dashing man who wears a mask of gray clay with dark gray lips that moves like a face to show his expression, and where his eyes should be are black pools with tiny blue reflected lights like a cat's eyes in the dark. He has very long, curling, dark red hair. His clothes, which cover every inch of his body, are finely made of black leather and suede over crimson, and he often wears a cloak to keep a low profile.

It was revealed in that Bolaire himself is a sentient mask that can take over the body of whomever wears the mask and does so every few months when his current form decays too much. In the darkness behind his clay lips there is an actual mouth that he uses to consume food and water in order to keep a body alive. On the other side of the mask the material seems slightly opalescent, and there is faint cursive writing under the eyes that can't be properly read unless one's face is close to the item itself. If someone spends long enough focusing on it, they hear the distant noise of an applause so thundering it feels as if the world was cracking from its core.

Taliesin describes Bolaire as "very social and bitchy". Although not a noble himself, Bolaire is comfortable in their company. He prefers to see things for himself rather than relying on the accounts of others. Almost all of his emotions are deliberate, based on what he thinks will be appropriate in each situation, with fear being the only "new" emotion he has acquired.
